translation: Bodiless, dwelling in bodies, intent on the worship of Kālī.
Resembling the state of one's own reflexive awareness — (the rest of the verse is lacunose in the source).
Of the form of space, named the Endless, bearing the eight forms — Śivā.

sanskrit: pretatve saṃsthitā nityaṃ tasyā devyāstu sarvataḥ ||1/ 5 ||
translation: She abides forever in the state of a corpse; of that Goddess — may it be so everywhere.
